name: ai-lab-assistant-platform
description: Monorepo for a localhost AI Lab Assistant platform.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix services/core-backend && npm install --prefix services/student-ui && npm install --prefix services/report-processor
scripts.dev: concurrently -n ai-core,core-backend,student-ui,report-processor -c blue,green,magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix services/ai-core" "npm run dev --prefix services/core-backend" "npm run dev --prefix services/student-ui" "npm run dev --prefix services/report-processor"
